mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.45 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation above 2.0% signals a hawkish monetary policy response to persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payroll growth above 150k signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where both UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 150.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) combined with rising residential construction (HOUST) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
